name: Stable Enough for 1.12.1
body:
- CPU/GPU AI voice generation locally free 
- Scrapes client data and when the pipeline runs it will sync the data back to the game
- Currently only compatible with 1.12.1 playing through to get more coverage
- Will track zones of NPCs with missing dialogue so that we can filter by zone while you progress through wow later
- Handles books, in game speech, portraits, VO, etc. 
- Modular design with good seperation of concerns at this point
- Good grouping for most NPCs to race/sex for appropriate VO assignment
